Nawo wonkhe tikwele sewunombala wenombolo yawo, gridi yeba yisifanekiso lesisemaphepheni. Tikwele letigcwele mibala lengaphandle kwaleyo ngulokwakho lesifanekiso, futsi umdlalo awutsi lutfo ngaso. "Gcwalisa ngetinombolo" ugcwalisa tikwele letingenalutfo tonkhe ngawe.
howTo: Khetsa saka gridi. 4 ngu-4 inetikwele letikhulu kakhulu futsi yiyo lenelula kunayo yonkhe.
Bheka khiyi phezulu kwegridi. Umbala ngulowo nalowo unenombolo kanye nelitfso, njengo-1 Yellow.
Tfinta umbala kukhiyi, bese utfinta tikwele lofuna kuzigcwalisa ngawo.
Sebentisa umbala lofana nenombolo, noma nguliphi lomcabango lowufunako. Kokubili kuyemukelekile.
Tfinta "Gcwalisa ngetinombolo" kutikwele letingenalutfo, "Sula" kuze uphindze uqale gridi, noma "Lesinye lesifanekiso" lesehlukile.
tips: Hlala ngasemadvodzeni nobe uyashintjashana: umuntfu munye ukhetsa umbala, lomunye ufaka tikwele.
Khuluma ngemibala: "Ngitsandza luhlaza." Akudzingeki kutsi utsi lesifanekiso sitawuba ngani.
Ku-screen lolincane i-gridi ye-8 ngu-8 iyaskrola ngekuhamba ngakhatsi kwayo yona. Tikwele tihlala tinkhulu lanelisako.
Kuphepha lokushicilelwe nako kuyasebenta ngemapensile etafuleni lelisemadvodzeni.

faq.a: Cha. Kute iwashi, emaphuyinti, kubalwa kwetinyatselo noma kulahlekelwa. Ungamisa noma nini, futsi kumisa uhhafu kuyindlela lenhle yekuphetsa.

faq.q: Kuticinile yini uma ngisebentisa umbala lohlukile kunenombolo?
faq.a: Akukho lokwenteka, futsi yilokho kubalulekile. Noma ngabe ngumbala muphi ungafakwa kunoma ngabe siphi sikwele, futsi umdlalo awutsi lutfo ngaso. Nawo wonkhe tikwele sewunombala wenombolo yawo, umdlalo uyatsi ngobumnene, futsi lesifanekiso semibala yakho sinebukhulu lofanako.

faq.q: Ingabe labantfu labanetinkinga temibala bangahlukanisa emibala lemine?
faq.a: Ikhethelwe kutsi batsi bangawuhlukanisa. Umbala ngamunye unenombolo, ligama labhaliwe kanye nesimo sawo lesincane, ngako umbala awusoze ube yindlela yodvwa yekuhlukanisa. Kugcwala lokune kuhlolwe ngetifanekiso temibono yekungaboni kahle kwemibala lebomvu-luhlaza nelubovu-lwenkhwari, futsi futsi ayehluka ekukhanyeni. Umuntfu lonekungaboni kahle kwemibala akakabi nawo umzamo, ngako sicela usitjele uma emabili angafanana.

faq.q: Ingabe tikwele tikhulu ngekwanele lekuhlupha kwesandla noma lesikrini lesincane?
faq.a: Ikwele ngalinye libanga ekhatsi kwe-48 pixels ebubanzi, futsi li-56 ku-gridi ye-4 ngu-4. Nangabe gridi inkhulu kakhulu kulesikrini, iyaskrola ngekuhamba ngakhatsi kwayo yona kunekutsi tikwele tinciphe.
Yebo. Lilakhi lelilodvwa linegridi lenetinombolo kanye nekhiyi yemibala emine ngemagama ayo. Dayela ikwele ngalinye ngepensile lemibala lefana nenombolo yalo, noma ngumbala loyifunako.
Ee, ikhululekile, futsi akudzingeki kuvula i-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kukhipha lutsatsi. Isebenta kusiphequluli se-web kufoni, kuthebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

pattern-maker.name: Umenzi wemaphethini
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Umenzi wemaphethini: Yakha ithayela bese ushicilela imaphethini
pattern-maker.h1: Umenzi wemaphethini: Yakha ithayela, ubone lipheindzeka
pattern-maker.description: Shintja tikwele tethayela letincane ubuke lisho kuphindzeka libe yimaphethini ecedvuna layo, ngemibala lemine ngayinye inelitfso nesimo sayo. Kute sikhatsi noma emaphuyinti. Kudlala nekushicilelwa kukhululekile.
pattern-maker.short: Shintja tikwele tethayela letincane ubuke lisho kuphindzeka libe yimaphethini.
pattern-maker.intro: Ithayela lincane letikwele ta-3 ngu-3, noma ta-4 ngu-4 nawufuna, kanye nalo ngasemadvodzeni: "imaphethini yakho", lethayela lifana lipheindzeka ngekwakha libhulokhi. Tfinta ikwele kutsi lishintje libe lelilandzelako kwemibala lemine, ngayinye inelitfso layo labhaliwe nesimo sayo. Imaphethini lesecedvuna layo iyashintja kwenyenya. Kute imaphethini lelungile, futsi kute lelugcinwako noma lelitfunyelwako. "Shicilela imaphethini yami" ibeka imaphethini lephindvwe ephepheni lelilodvwa lokugcina, lokudayela nalokuniketa.
howTo: Bheka ithayela nemaphethini yakho lacecedvuna layo. Ngitsi ithayela lifanako, liphindzwe.
Tfinta ikwele. Liyashintja libe ngumbala lolandzelako emgceni wemibala lemine lolungentasi ngenhla.
Yetsemba kutfinta tikwele kuze imaphethini ifana nendlela lofuna ngayo. Noma ngabe yiphi imaphethini ilungile.
Tfinta "Ngimangalise" ngethayela lelisha, noma "Ake siqale kabusha" ngelingenalutfo. "Ubuyisele" ibuyisa ithayela lebewunalo.
Tfinta "Shicilela imaphethini yami" uma ufuna kutsi ibe ephepheni, noma tfinta Phumula kuze umise.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person taps a square, the other says what they notice.
Talk about what you see: "That looks like a flower." There is no need to name anything.
Try the same tile in just two colors, then again in all four.
On paper, the pattern can be colored in with pencils, cut into strips for a card, or used to wrap a small gift.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho sikhathi, umphumela, sibalo semidlalo noma kulahleka. Ungayeka nanoma nini, futsi ukuyeka uphakathi kuyindlela lenhle yekugcina.
Cha. Logodvwa lakho lihlala kulelikhasi kuphela. Ayigcinwa, ayilayishwa, futsi ayibalwa, futsi iyanyamalala uma uvala likhasi. Uma ufuna kugcina lephethini, yiphrinte.

faq.q: Kungani ngicindzetela sikwele lesingekho noma ngisule lologodvwa ngephutsa?
faq.a: Akukho sikwele lesingekho: cindzetela kuso futsi ukuze uye emtfuntfu lolandzelako. Ngemuva kwe-"Qala futsi" noma "Ngikhetele", "Ubuyisele" ubuyisela logodvwa lebewunalo.

faq.q: Ingabe bantfu labanemakhono lamabi ekubona emibala bayakwati kuhlukanisa emibala lemine?
faq.a: Yakhetfwa ngaleyo ndlela. Umbala ngulowo nalowo unelibito lakhona lelibhalwe, nesimo sawo lesincane esikhethekile kulo lonkhe sikwele, ngako umbala awusoze ube yindlela kuphela yekuhlukanisa. Emibala lemine ihlolwe ngetindlela letilingisa kungaboni kahle kubomvu nekwatsi, nekuboshwa nekutfwala. Umuntu longaboni kahle emibaleni lacondvwe ngaye akakavi, ngako sicela utitsele uma emabili afana.

faq.q: Ingabe sikwele sikhulu ngekwanele kumuntu lonematfuthfuva noma kusikrini lesincane?
faq.a: Sikwele ngasinye sibanga kungenani ema-pixel angu-56. Uma logodvwa lubanti kakhulu kusikrini, luyahamba ngebhakabhaka ngaphakathi kwebhokisi layo kunekutsi emasikwele ancipheke.
Yebo. "Phrinta lephethini yami" iphrinta lephethini lowenta ekhasini linye, ngemibala lemine nemabito awo, lehle nakuba ngemnyama nemhlophe ngoba umbala ngulowo nalowo unesimo sawo.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi akudzingeki i-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Kuyasebenta kusiphequluli sewebhu esiselfoneni, ethabhulethi noma ekhompyutheni.

drawing-duet.name: Drawing duet
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Drawing Duet: Two People, One Picture
drawing-duet.h1: Drawing Duet: Two People, One Sheet
drawing-duet.description: Two people take turns drawing lines on one shared canvas, each in a color of their own. Nobody scores or wins, and the picture can be saved or printed. Free to play, with no account.
drawing-duet.short: Take turns drawing one shared picture with someone beside you.
drawing-duet.intro: One canvas, two people. Each of you picks a color, and each color has its own written name. You take turns: draw one line or shape, then pass the pen. Either of you may pass at any time. There is no right picture and no score. Save the picture to your device if you like it, or print the paper version: one sheet, two pens.
howTo: Each of you picks a color. The banner says whose turn it is, with that person's color by name.
Draw one line or shape with a finger, a mouse or a pen. Or use the arrow keys and Space to draw without a pointer.
When you are ready, tap "Pass the pen". Either of you may pass at any time.
Tap "Take back my last line" to remove the newest line of the person whose turn it is.
Tap "Save picture" to make a picture file on this device, or "Print the paper version" for one sheet and two pens.
tips: Sit side by side and talk as you draw: "I will add a sun in the corner."
Start with a dot, a line or a simple shape, and let the other person answer it.
Nobody has to draw a picture of anything. A pattern of lines is just as good as a scene.
If you want to stop, tap "Done for now". Your picture is not kept after you leave the page unless you save it.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho mcolisi, umphumela, sikhathi noma sibalo semagadango. Akukho lipikha lelilungile, futsi akukho lokuhlelwa noma lokuqhathaniswa.
Cha, akukho lokutfunyelwa naphi. Lipikha lihlala kulelikhasi kuze kuvalwe. Uma ucindzetela Gcina lipikha, kwenta lifayela ekhompyutheni yakho lolungele kulanda. Akulayishwa lutfo.
Yebo. "Susa umugca wami wekugcina" isusa umugca lomusha walowo lobe sikhatsi sakhe. "Qala futsi" isula sikhwama, futsi "Ubuyisele" ibuyisela imigca, sinyatelo sinye kuphela.

faq.q: Ingabe ngingasebentisa lokhu ngaphandle kwesilwane sekuhamba nesikrini lesitfintsha?
faq.a: Yebo. Lapho lipikha linendzaba, tinkinobho letinsenti letinsite tihambisa mchemo wepeni, futsi inkinobho yeSpace ifaka noma ikhiphe peni. Sikrini sitsi "Peni lehla" noma "Peni lenyuka" njalo nje.

faq.q: Yimiphi imibala, futsi bantfu labanemakhono lamabi ekubona emibala bayakwati kuyihlukanisa?
faq.a: Liphuzi, lolucambu, luhlaza nalobovu, iyemibala lefanana nalena lesetjentiswa kuwo lamanye emidlalo yetithombe. Umbala ngulowo nalowo unelibito lelibhalwe, futsi emabito atfolakala ngaseceleni kwesikhatsi. Emibala ihlolwe ngetindlela letilingisa kwehluka kwemibono yemibala lejwayelekile, kodvwa umuntu lonehluka kwemibono yemibala akakavi.

Yebo. "Phrinta lephepha lelitfolakalako" iphrinta likhasi linye lalo kulotfwe imitsetfo, nelirabha lelikhulu lelingenalo lilwa lapho kudweba khona, kubantfu labetfu nemapeni lamabili. Iyasebenta ngemnyama nemhlophe.
Ee, kuyamahhala, futsi akukho akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Iyasebenta kusiphequluli sewebhu esiveni, ku-tablet noma kukhompyutha.

build-together.name: Akhani ndzawonye
build-together.seoTitle: Akhani Ndzawonye: Bantfu Lababili Bakha Liphethini Linye
build-together.h1: Akhani Ndzawonye: Bantfu Lababili, Gridi Linye
build-together.description: Bantfu lababili bayashintshana kufaka sitfuba esigridini lesabelekile kuze kugcwale, ngalunye nembala wayo lenegama lenhlobo yayo. Akukho lowinako, futsi akukho sikhatsi noma umphumela. Kuyamahhala kudlala nakushicilela.
build-together.short: Shintshana nemuntfu losedvute nawe ugcwalise gridi lesabelekile linye.
build-together.intro: Gridi lesabelekile lebandla lesi-4 ngesi-4, noma lesi-3 ngesi-3 uma ufisa. Ngalunye kuni ukhetsa umbala, futsi umbala ngalunye unegama lawo lolubhaliwe nenhlobo yawo. Nishintshana: ngesikhatsi sakho, thepha indzawo lengenalutfo ukuze ufake sitfuba sakho khona. Nasebandleni ngalinye selinesitfuba,liphethini lakhiwe ndzawonye. Akukho lowinako, ngoba nakha nisebhangqwini, futsi akukho lokugcinwako noma lokutfumelwako. "Shicilela igridi" ibeka igridi lelingenalutfo esikhumbini esisodvwa kutsi nakhe ngemapenseli emabili.
howTo: Ngalunye kuni ukhetsa umbala. Umbala lowusetjentiswa yimuntfu lomunye uyamakwa ngekutsi "Uyasetjentiswa".
Umuntfu lokucala ukhetsa kucala. Lesikrini sitsi kuyasikhatsi sencimbi, nemba wakhe ngumuphi.
Thepha indzawo lengenalutfo ukuze ufake sitfuba sakho khona. Sikhatsi sidlulela kumuntfu lomunye.
Uma ungafuni kufaka sitfuba, thepha "Dlulisa". Noma ngubani kuni angadlulisa noma nini.
Nasebandleni ngalinye selinesitfuba, liphethini liakhiwe ndzawonye. Thepha "Qala kabusha" ukuze wakhe lenye, noma thepha Phumula ukuze umise.
tips: Hlala ngasemakhethe ukuze nobabili nikwati kubona nekufinyelela lesikrini. Khuluma ngesikhatsi nisenta: "Ngitawufaka lowami elubhekene nalowakho."
Zama ukwakha liphethini, tinhlebe, ibhodi lemabalabala lensundvu, noma ufake titfusi nanoma kuphi ulutsandza. Kokubili kuyatemukeka.
Umntfwana noma umuntfu lokhatsatekako kalula angadlulisa kangaka kangangoba afuna. Liphethini lisakhiwa ndzawonye.
Ngephepha, ngalunye usebentisa lipenseli linye kanti udweba sitfusi sakhe etikwenetikweni letingenalutfo.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho lowinako, ngoba nakha liphethini linye ndzawonye. Akukho ligzo, umphumela, kubalwa kwetitfusi noma kulahleka. Ungayeka nanoma yisiphi sikhatsi, futsi kuyeka ngesikhatsi selinye kuyindlela lenhle yekuphetsa.

faq.q: Yini lesakhiwa nayo ilondvolotwa noma itfumelwa?
faq.a: Cha. Igridi lihlala kulelikhasi kuphela. Ayilondvolotwa, ayilayishwa noma ayibalwa, futsi iyanyamalala uma uvala likhasi. Uma ufuna kuyigcina, shicilela igridi wakhe ephepheni.
Akukho indzawo lengafanele. Thepha "Buyisa sitfuba lesigcina" nesikhatsi sibuyele kuwe. Ungabuyisa sinyatselo ngasinye, futsi nekudlulisa kungabuyiswa.

faq.q: Imibala lemine ingehlukaniswa ngabantfu lababona kancane imibala?
faq.a: Yakhetfwa kutsi ibe njalo. Umbala ngalunye unegama lawo lolubhaliwe nenhlobo yawo lencane esitfubeni ngasinye, kutsi umbala awusoze wabe yindlela yodvwa yekuyehlukanisa. Imibala lemine ihlolwe ngetifanekiso temtfondvo lobomvu nalohlaza, nalobuluhlaza nalophuzi. Umuntfu lobona kancane imibala akakabi nayo imizamo, ngako sicela usitjele uma emabili afana.

faq.q: Ingabe tindzawo tikhulu kwanele ngetinyathelo netikrini letincane?
faq.a: Indzawo ngalunye ibanga langaphansi kwema-56 ma-pixel. Uma gridi likhulu kakhulu lesikrinini, liyahamba ngebanga lebhokisi layo kunekutsi tindzawo tinciphe.

Yebo. "Shicilela igridi" ishicilela igridi lelingenalutfo esikhumbini lesisodvwa lesinemibala lemibili namagama ayo, kutsi nakhe ngemapenseli emabili. Iyasebenta nguboMnyama noMhlophe, ngoba umbala ngalunye unenhlobo yawo.
Ee, kuyamahhala, futsi akukho akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Iyasebenta kusiphequluli sewebhu esiveni, ku-tablet noma kukhompyutha.

seated-toss.name: Kubalwa kwekuphosa ngihleti
seated-toss.seoTitle: Kubalwa Kwekuphosa Ngihleti: Umdlalo Wekuphosa Sikhwama Semabhini Kubantfu Lababili
seated-toss.h1: Kubalwa Kwekuphosa Ngihleti: Phosa Ndzawonye Etafuleni
seated-toss.description: Bantfu lababili etafuleni bayashintshana kuphosa sikhwama semabhini lesithambile kulotfo lolukhulu bese bagcina kubalwa ephepheni. Akukho sikhatsi noma umphumela lobhalwako. Kuyamahhala kushicilela.
seated-toss.short: Shintshana kuphosa sikhwama semabhini kulotfo lolukhulu, kubalwa kugcinwe ephepheni.
seated-toss.intro: Umdlalo lotfulile wekuphosa wemuntfu lababili labahlezi etafuleni. Ubeka lotfo lolushicilelwe etafuleni bese nishintshana kuphosa sikhwama semabhini lesithambile, noma umjingi wesokisi lulotfushiwe, kutsi lehlele emasongweni. Ngalunye kuni ugcina kubalwa ngekutfula emabhokisini ephepheni, bese nibuka kutfula ndzawonye nakhumula. Akukho sikhatsi lesibalwako esikrinini, futsi akukho lokugcinwako noma lokutfumelwako. Sicela ufundze tinhlanhla letisemtsetfweni kucala: tigcwaliso letincane tingaba yingoti yekuhlanganiswa.
howTo: Fundza tinhlanhla letisemtsetfweni. Khetsa sikhwama lesinemboza lelitfungwe ngesitselo, noma lulotfushe sokisi lehlanzekile.
Thepha "Shicilela lotfo nelibheshi lekubala" ubeke ilibheshi libhasile etafuleni phakathi kwenu.
Hlala kahle, ngulumunye ngasohlangothini ngulumunye, nishintshane ngekuphosa kanye ngasinye ngobumnene. Noma ngubani angadlulisa.
Uma kuphosa kuwela esongweni, futsi tfula ibhokisi ekholomini yakho, emugceni lowusongweni lolo.
Buka kutfula ndzawonye nakhumula, noma thepha Phumula ukuze umise.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "That was a soft one." Everyone cheers for every toss.
A rolled-up sock is light and easy to hold with a weak grip. Rest an arm on the table between turns.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho wotshwala, umphumela, umbhalo wemidlalo noma kulahlekelwa. Ungayeka noma nini, futsi ukuyeka uhhafu kuyindlela lehle yekuphetsa.

Kungaba kuphephile, uma unakekela. Sebenzisa sikhwama lelinesiciko lelisongiwe noma umjaca lowujikeleziwe, hhayi emabhini, emaraysi noma tintfo letincane letingagcwala, lezingaba yingoti kubantfwana labancane nakubo bonkhe labafaka tintfo emlonyeni. Hlala phansi, uphose kancane etafuleni futsi ungaphosi ebusweni, futsi nemdzala abe seduze.
Cha. Kubalwa kwenkhokhelo kusephepheni kuphela, etibhokisini lotikhomba ngekutsi tiyakwenta.Lelitsebhu alibali, alinasikhatsi, futsi kute lokugcinwako noma lokutfunyelwako.

faq.q: Kwenta njani uma umuntu angakwati kuphosa, noma sikhwama singena ngaphandle kwesheet?
faq.a: Umuntu longakwati angadlulisa ngekutsi ayeke, futsi sikhwama lesingena ngaphandle kwesheet siyatfolakala siphindze siphoswe ngesikhatsi lesilandzelako. Akukho lokubalwako ngaso.

Ikhasi linye: sijikijelo lesikhulu lenemajingo lamatsatfu lamagama ngekutsi Eduze, Phakatsi naKude, letafula linekholomu yemuntfu ngamunye nemugca wetibhokisi letincane lotakukhomba ngayo ngemajingo ngamanye, nemugca wetiluleko tekuphepha. Emagama abhalwe emajingweni, ngako asebenta nakuba mnyama nemhlophe.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi akudzingeki i-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Isebenta ku-web browser esakhiweni, ethabhulethi noma ekhompyutheni.

seasonal-pack.name: Lolubuhlanganisi lwemiphakelo yalesikhathi
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Lolubuhlanganisi Lwemiphakelo Yalesikhathi: Imiphakelo Yephepha Lelishicilelwako
seasonal-pack.h1: Lolubuhlanganisi Lwemiphakelo Yalesikhathi: Imiphakelo Yephepha Lemi-3 Ngenyanga Ngayinye
seasonal-pack.description: Imiphakelo lemi-3 lelincane lelishicilelwako nganoma yiyiphi inyanga yemnyaka: hambisa emaphayeri, bhala sitsandzo lesehlukile, bese udaya sitfombe. Ikhasi livula kulenyanga, noma ukhetse lenye, noma usikhetse lilanga lekuphumula. Kushicilela kumahhala.
seasonal-pack.short: Imiphakelo lemi-3 lelishicilelwako yenyanga oyikhetsako, noma lilanga lekuphumula.
seasonal-pack.players: Tonkhe timnyaka, wedvwa noma ecaleni kwemunye
seasonal-pack.intro: Khetsa inyanga, bese ikhasi likhombisa imiphakelo lemi-3 lelincane yephepha lelakhiwe kutitsombe tenyanga leyo: imigca lemi-2 yekuhlanganisa ngemigca, umgca wemi-4 wekujikeleta lesehlukile, nesitfombe sekudaya. Ikhasi livula ngenyanga yamanje yedivayisi yakho. Ushicilela ikhasi linye, bese wenta lo-1, lo-2 noma tonkhe leta-3, ngalisinga lakho. Khetsa "Namuhla lilanga lekuphumula" esikhundzeni salokho, bese kute lokwentako.
howTo: Khetsa inyanga, noma khetsa "Namuhla lilanga lekuphumula".
Buka imiphakelo lemi-3, bese utfwesa "Shicilela lelubuhlanganisi lwenyanga".
Yenta lo-1, lo-2 noma tonkhe leta-3, ngalisinga lakho.
Hlanganisa titsombe letifanako ngemugca, jikeleta lesehlukile, bese udaya sitfombe lesikhulu.
Yeka nanini lapho ufuna khona. Lilanga lekuphumula nalo lilanga lelihle.
tips: Qala ngemphakelo lodzingeka ube lula namuhla. Lo-1 uyanele.
Tsi magama etitfombe ngalinye ngekuphimisa, uma kusita.
Sebenisa tikhilayoni noma tipensela. Noma yimiphi imibala ilungile.
Gcina ikhasi lesikhatsi lesitako, noma lishiye.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho wotshwala, umphumela, umbhalo wemidlalo noma kulahlekelwa. Ungayeka noma nini, futsi ukuyeka uhhafu kuyindlela lehle yekuphetsa.

faq.q: Ikhasi liyati yini ukuthi yiliphi sikhatsi lemnyaka?
faq.a: Cha. Wena ukhetsa sikhatsi. Ikhasi aliboni lusuku noma indzawo yakho.

faq.q: Kukhona umphumela noma impendulo leshayako yini?
faq.a: Cha. Kute lokuchonywako ngesikhatsi, lokuphawulwako noma lokuhlolwako esikrinini, futsi kute timphendvulo letikhonjiwako. Ipuzzle ngalinye sitfombe nje lesibukwako, lesihlanganiswako, lesijikelezwako noma lesidayekako.

faq.q: Kwenta njani uma kute lofuna imiphakelo namuhla?
faq.a: Khetsa "Namuhla lilanga lekuphumula". Ikhasi lesikhombisa umugca munye lowuthulile, futsi kute lokushicilelwako noma lokwentako.
Ikhasi linye lesikhatsi losikhethile: imiphakelo yaso lemi-3, ngalinye linemugca lomfishane wekutsi lenziwa njani, nemugca lotsi ungenta lo-1, lo-2 noma tonkhe leta-3.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi akudzingeki i-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Isebenta ku-web browser esakhiweni, ethabhulethi noma ekhompyutheni.

decorate-a-card.name: Hobisa likhadi ndzawonye
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Hobisa Likhadi Ndzawonye: Likhadi Lekwetfula Lelishicilelwako
decorate-a-card.h1: Hobisa Likhadi Ndzawonye: Lenta Lelinye Ngalomunye Umuntfu
decorate-a-card.description: Bantfu labambili bahobisa likhadi lekwetfula lelishicilelwako lelisuka lilusuku lekuzalwa, lelisuka lelibonga noma nje, bese bebhala umlayeto emuva ndzawonye. Tikhilayoni noma tipeni kuphela. Akukho sikhatsi noma umphumela. Kushicilela kumahhala.
decorate-a-card.intro: Umdlalo wekwenta lokutsi ulale phansi kwebantfu labambili labahlala ecaleni kwe-munye. Ushicilela incwadzi linye, lebhukwa libe ngesigaba lesisodvwa kuvele likhadi. Khetsa sisusa, njengelusuku lekuzalwa noma lebonga, bese uhobisa ingaphambili lisuke emagameni alo. Bese ubhala umlayeto emuva, ndzawonye noma umuntfu lobhala loko lotsi longakushoyo lomunye. Sebenta tikhilayoni, tipensela letinemibala noma ti-felt-tip. Kute likhadi lelilungile, futsi kute lokuchonywako ngesikhatsi, lokuphawulwako noma lokutfunyelwako.
howTo: Hlola sikhatsi, bese utfumele "Print the card".
Gogoda incwadzi ngasemgceni wayo lolumtfwele, ukuze ingaphandle libe ngaphandle.
Umuntu munye uhlobisa ingaphandle, lomunye uhlobisa ingaphambili, noma nitfole kancane seluleko ngaseceleni linye.
Bhalani umyalezo ndzawonye. Umuntu munye angabhala kantsi lomunye ashoya emagama.
Yima noma nini lapho ufuna khona. Likhadi lelilula lilungile njengelo lelihlobisekile kakhulu.
tips: Qala ngemagama asengaphambili, bese wengeta emaqabunga, tinkanyezi noma timphondvo ngakunye ngakunye ondzeni wawo.
Uma umuntu angatsandzi kudvweba, angakhetsa tindzawo noma abhale umyalezo.
Chaza kutsi uyatsandza yini tinhlobo tomunye umuntu, hhayi kutsi tihle yini.
Gcina likhadi endzaweni lapho lingayinikwa khona, noma nje lisale etafuleni okwesikhatsi manje.

faq.a: Cha. Kute sikhatsi, umphumelelo, sibalo semahambiso noma kulahlekelwa. Ungayeka noma nini, futsi kuyeka uhhafu kuyindlela lelungile yekuphetsa.

faq.q: Ingabe sidzinga ugovo, emasikelo noma tisitika?
faq.a: Cha. Tikhrayoni, tipensile letinemibala noma tipeni letinemzimba letimbe ayanele. Kute lokudzingeka kunciphwe, kugovwe noma kunamatiselwe.
Khetsa "Just because" bese ubhala emagama wakho ngaphambili, noma uhlobise likhadi ngaphandle kwesikhatsi lesitsite.

faq.q: Kukhona lokubalwa, lokugwetwa noma lokugcinwa esikrinini?
faq.a: Cha. Likhasi likhombisa likhadi kuphela netinyatselo. Akukho lokubekwa emkhatsini, lokubalwa noma lokugcinwa, futsi kute likhadi lelilungile.
Likhasi linye: likhadi lelilungetwe ngesigamu, linemagama wesikhatsi nemphanderho lula ngaphambili, kanti ngemuva kunemigca yemyalezo nemgca we-From. Timiso temuntfu lobabili ishicilelwe ngaphansi.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi kute i-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kukhipha. Isebenta kusiphequluli seweb kumfowoni, kuthebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

find-together.name: Find together
find-together.seoTitle: Find Together: Two People Find the Pairs
find-together.h1: Find Together: Two People, One Team
find-together.description: Two people share one screen and take turns turning over two picture cards to look for a pair. Pairs are found together and counted on one shared tally. Free to play, with no timer or score.
find-together.short: Take turns with someone beside you to find the picture pairs.
find-together.intro: The cards start with their pictures showing, or you can lay them face down. On your turn you turn over two cards. If they are a pair, you have found it together and the turn passes. If they are different, they stay face up until you press "Turn them back", so you can both look. Pass at any time. The tally at the top only goes up: the pairs you have found together.
howTo: Khetsa kutsi ufuna kusebentisa tikhadi lingaki. Tikhadi letisitfupha, emapheya lamatsatfu, kuyindzawo lentsulekile yekuqala.
Sikrini sitsi ngubani lophendukako, nomunye lapho kuyinhlangotsi yekucala kunesiyenge, kanti yekucala kunesikwele.
Phendvulula tikhadi letimbili, lilandzelana. Uma tilingana, ipheya itfolakale ndzawonye.
Uma tihlukile, cindzetela "Turn them back" nxa nobabili nilungile. Lishintsho selitfutsela komunye.
Noma ngubani kubo angacindzetela "Pass" noma nini. Tfwela "Start again" tikhadi letitsha, noma tfwela Rest kuze uyeke.
tips: Hlala ngaseceleni bese nitsi emagama tifananeko ngekhwela ndzawonye: "Inkomishi yetiti. Uyayitsandza yini ti nobisi?"
Vumela umuntu lotakunakekela akhiphe tinhlobo, noma kutsatsa sikhatsi. Khomba esikhundleni sekutsintsa kuze nemtsetfo.
Khetsa "Cards face down" uma nobabili nitfokotelela kuphendvulula tikhadi kutfola tifanekiso.
Umuntu lokhatsatekako kalula angayeka noma kangaki lokufunako. Emapheya atfolakala ndzawonye.

faq.a: Cha. Kute lowinako, ngoba emapheya ataholakala njengelikhambi. Kute sikhatsi, umphumelelo noma sibalo sekuphutsa. Sibalo sibala kuphela emapheya atfolakale ndzawonye, futsi ungayeka noma nini.

faq.q: Kudzingeka sikhumbule kutsi tifanekiso tisendzaweni yini?
faq.a: Cha. Umdlalo uqala nawo onkhe tifanekiso ebukeka. Uma tikhadi litfotfobele, ningabutana kutsi nibone kani, noma nitfole ngekuphendvula futsi.

faq.q: Kwenteka kani uma tikhadi bobili tihlukile?
faq.a: Tisala tibukeka, kuze nobabili nikwati kutibuka, sikhatsi lesidzingekako. Akukho lokutibuyisa emuva ngekwayo. Nalungela, cindzetela "Turn them back" kuze lishintsho lidlulele komunye umuntu.
Cha. Tikhadi tihlala kulelikhasi kuphela. Kute lokugcinwa, lokulayishwa noma lokubalwa, futsi kuyanyamalala uma uvala likhasi.

faq.q: Ingabe tikhadi tikhulu ngekwanele kumtfumo noma sikrini lesincane?
faq.a: Likhadi ngalinye linesidze lesingenani le-64 pixels, futsi likhulu kangangoba sikrini sivumela. Labo basebentisa khibhodi nemfundzi yesikrini bayitfola likhadi ngalinye ngendzawo yalo nangetifanekiso talo.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi kute i-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kukhipha. Isebenta kusiphequluli seweb kumfowoni, kuthebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

story-dice.name: Story dice
story-dice.seoTitle: Story Dice: a Picture Storytelling Game
story-dice.h1: Story Dice: Tell a Story with Pictures
story-dice.description: Three or four picture dice to tell a story with, in any order. No reading, no right answer, no timer and no score. Roll again, or pass. Free to play and print.
story-dice.short: Roll picture dice and tell a story together, in any order.
story-dice.players: 2 or more people, or an adult and a child
story-dice.intro: Kukhonjwa tithombe 3 noma 4, tifana netidayisi. Ndzawonye, akhe indzaba lesebentisa tithombe, nangabe ngalelihlelo lofuna. Indzaba ingaba sitsatfo sinye noma letimbalwa, ingaba yemahlaya noma yalokwenteka ensimini yemphilo yansuku ngensuku. Alikho indzaba lelifanele kuphela, futsi akudzingeki kutsi umuntfu ataye noma akhumbule ligama. Cinisa “Phindza futsi” uze utfole tithombe letitsha, futsi noma ngubani angadlula.
howTo: Khetsa tidayisi 3 noma 4. 3 yiyo leyilula kakhulu.
Bukani tithombe ndzawonye. Cinisa leyo lapho ufuna kuqala khona.
Shintshana ukuchaza indzaba lesebentisa tithombe, nangabe ngalelihlelo lofuna. Umusho munye uyanele ngumuntfu ngamunye.
Noma ngubani angadlula. Cinisa “Dlula”, lowo lolandzelako angaqala.
Cinisa “Phindza futsi” uma ufuna tithombe letitsha nanoma nini, noma cinisa “Phumula” ukuze umise.
tips: Buta umbuzo esikhundleni sekulindza impendulo: “Isambulela singase siye kuphi?”
Engeza kulokushiwo ngumuntfu wakwangaphambili esikhundleni sekumlungisa. Noma iyiphi indzaba iyemukelwa.
Indzaba ingamenyelwa ngenkhumbulo yangempilo yakho. Sithombe lesihle kakhulu kuyo singaba kuqala.

faq.a: Cha. Alikho sikhatsi, umphumela, kubalwa kwetinyatselo noma kulahlekelwa. Ungamisa nanoma nini, futsi kumisa emaphakathi kuyindlela lelungile yekuphetsa.

faq.q: Kufanele ngifundze noma ngichaze tithombe yini?
faq.a: Cha. Umdlalo usebenta ngetithombe kuphela. Badlali bangatsenta, bachaze, noma batsi nje sithombe sibakhumbuta ntfo. Akukho muntfu locelwa kutsi acale ligama noma akhumbule ntfo.

faq.q: Yini uma umuntfu angafuni kudlala ngalesikhatsi?
faq.a: Angadlula nanoma nini, futsi angachazi kutsi ngani. Umdlalo uyalindza, futsi umuntfu lolandzelako angaqala, noma ningaphindza nitsatse tithombe letitsha.
Yebo. Liphepha lelilodvwa linetithombe 16 letihlukene, letihleleke emigceni 4. Khetsa umugca, noma unciphe tithombe, uticatsulele etindzeni.

faq.q: Ngabe kumahhala yini, futsi kudzingeka ngibhalise?
faq.a: Yebo, kumahhala, futsi alikho akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Kusebenta kubhrawuza yewebhu efonini, ethebulethi noma ekhompyutheni.

word-and-picture-pairs.name: Emapheya emagama netithombe
word-and-picture-pairs.seoTitle: Emapheya Emagama Netithombe: Hlanganisa Emagama Netithombe
word-and-picture-pairs.h1: Emapheya Emagama Netithombe: Hlanganisa Ligama Nalesithombe
word-and-picture-pairs.description: Hlanganisa emagama lesiNgisi netithombe talo, futsi uve noma liliphi gama lifundziwa ngelikhala. Tithombe tihlala tibonakala, kute sikhatsi, umphumela noma kubalwa kwemazama. Kuyamahhala kudlala futsi kushicilela.
word-and-picture-pairs.short: Hlanganisa ligama ngalinye nesithombe salo, futsi ulizwe lifundzwa ngelikhala.
word-and-picture-pairs.intro: Kukhonjwa tithombe 4 noma 6, emagama ayo esiNgisi akhonjwe ngalolunye luhlelo. Thinta ligama bese uthinta sithombe salo, noma thinta sithombe bese ligama. Lipheya lelihlanganisiwe lihlala lihlanganile ngemdzibhi lomkhulu nemagama ati “Ihlanganisiwe”. Thinta “Fundzela ngekhala” ecaleni kwalo naliphi gama uve lifundziwa. Akukho sikhatsi noma umphumela lobalwako, futsi kuthinta lokungafanani kuyasuswa.
howTo: Khetsa tithombe 4 noma 6. 4 yiyo leyilula kakhulu.
Thinta ligama, bese uthinta sithombe lisisho. Noma thinta sithombe kucala, bese ligama laso.
Lipheya lelihlanganisiwe lihlala lihlanganile. Kuthinta lokungafanani kuyacisha ngekuthula, ngako zama lokunye.
Thinta “Fundzela ngekhala” ecaleni kwegama uve lifundziwa, uma idivayisi yakho ingakhuluma umbhalo.
Thinta “Tithombe letitsha” kulesinye sethi, noma “Qala kabusha” ukuze uhlukanise tonkhe tiphayeri. “Buyisela” ibuyisa lokuhlanganisiwe kwakucala.
tips: Shelana kutsi ngalinye ligama ngelikhala ndzawonye ngaphambi kwekulihlanganisa, futsi khuluma ngesithombe.
Imindeni ingatinikana sikhatsi. Ngulowo nalowo akhetsa ligama noma sithombe ngasikhatsi sinye.
Sebentisa emagama lowati kakade kucala, bese ulishiya lalokunye kamuva.

faq.a: Cha. Alikho sikhatsi, umphumela, kubalwa kwetinyatselo noma kulahlekelwa. Ungamisa nanoma nini, futsi kumisa emaphakathi kuyindlela lelungile yekuphetsa.
Yakhelwe bantfu labadzala labatifundzako noma labuyela kutifundza emagama lesiNgisi, nemindeni edlala ndzawonye. Kayibhalelwe bantfwana.

faq.q: Yini uma idivayisi yami ingeke ikwati kufundzela umbhalo ngelikhala?
faq.a: Inkinobho “Fundzela ngekhala” isebentisa livi lebhulawuza yakho lesele. Uma lebhulawuza ingeke ikhulume, inkinobho ayikhonjwa, futsi umdlalo usebenta ngaphandle kwayo.
Yebo. Liphepha lelilodvwa linetithombe 6 nemagama aso 6, ticatsulelwe noma ticoshwe ngemugca.

faq.q: Ngabe kumahhala yini, futsi kudzingeka ngibhalise?
faq.a: Yebo, kumahhala, futsi alikho akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Kusebenta kubhrawuza yewebhu efonini, ethebulethi noma ekhompyutheni.

sort-together.name: Hlela ndzawonye
sort-together.seoTitle: Umdlalo Wekuhlela: Hlelana Ndzawonye Kubantfu Labadzala
sort-together.description: Thinta sithombe, bese libhasikidi lelifanele: ekhishini noma egceni, sithelo noma tilwane. Umdlalo wekuhlela lokuthulile lomahhala wabantfu labadzala nemindeni.
sort-together.short: Faka sithombe ngasinye enkhuseni yaso: ekhishini noma egcweleni, nemanye.
sort-together.intro: Kuhlela ngumsebenti lowatiwa kahle futsi lojabulisako emalanga onkhe, njengekubeka tintfo ekhabethini noma kuhlanganisa emasokisi. Chayani sithombe, bese nichaya inkhuseni lapho lesifanele khona. Akukho kusheshisa futsi akukho kuphambuka lokungalungile.
howTo: Khetsani indzikinsi: ekhishini negcweleni, sithelo netilwane, noma ekhaya nasemaphandleni.
Chayani sithombe. Siba nemgca wegolide.
Chayani inkhuseni lesifanele kuyo. Sithombe sitawungena kuleyo nkhuseni.
Uma sifanele enye inkhuseni, umdlalo utsi kahle bese ulindzele.
Lapho sonkhe tithombe sesihlelekile, bukisisani tinkhuseni ndzawonye.
tips: Empilweni yansuku ngensuku akusoze kube nemphendvulo lengalungile. Uma umuntfu atsi sipho sekuntjitsa sifanele ekhishini, buta ngekutsi kungani. Ungakutfola kuhle lokutsi.
Sebentisani tithombe njengesikhumbuzo: “Nalitelela yini egcweleni lakho?”
Kuhlela tintfo langempilo, njengemacembe nemafolokhwe noma tinkinobho ngemibala, kuba ngumsebenti lomuhle lolandzelako ngaphandle kwesikrini.

Bantfu abanyenti bajabulela kuhlela ngoba kuva njengemsebenti lowusitfolako futsi lowatiwa kahle. Kuphindze kube lula kuxoxa ngetithombe lapho nichubeka.

picture-puzzle.name: Puzzle yesithombe
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Umdlalo Wekuhlanganisa Tincele Ulula Ku-inthanethi: Tincele 4 Noma 9 Letikhulu
picture-puzzle.description: Umdlalo wekuhlanganisa tincele ulula wabantfu labadzala: tincele 4 noma 9 letikhulu, sithombe lesiphelele sibonakala, futsi uthinta tincele mbili kuze ushintshane. Sebentisa sithombe sakho, lesihlala kulidivayisi lolu. Kuyamahhala, akukho sikhatsi.
picture-puzzle.short: Chayani tincumo letimbili kuze tishintsane kuze sithombe siphelele.
picture-puzzle.intro: Sithombe lesihle sinqunyiwe sibe ngetincele 4 noma 9 letikhulu, bese siyaxutshwa. Sithombe lesiphelele sihlala sibonakala njengesiqondiso. Thinta incele munye, bese uthinta lenye, futsi ayashintsha tindzawo. Akudzingeki kudonsa. Ungasebentisa nesithombe sakho. Sihlala kulidivayisi lolu futsi asiyi kulayishwa noma kumiswa kunoma ngumuphi umshini.

Bukisisani sithombe sonkhe esendzaweni lephezulu.
Chayani incumo, bese nichaya sindzawo lapho lesifanele khona. Tincumo letimbili tiyashintsha.
Tincumo lesendzaweni lefanele tiba nemaki lamancane lakhangako.
Lapho sithombe siphelele, sijabulele ndzawonye, bese nikhetsa lesinye.
tips: Kuchaya tincumo letimbili kutishintsha kulula kakhulu kunekudonsa kubantfu abanyenti.
Khulumani ngesithombe lesihlanganako: “Nalapha lophahla lolubomvu.”

Akudzingeki. Chaya incumo linye, bese lelinye, tiyashintsha tindzawo. Kulula kakhulu nasandla sinyenyetela noma esikrinini lesincane.

finish-the-saying.name: Phetsa inkhulumo
finish-the-saying.description: Tinkhulumo letijwayelekile tesiSwati letilishoda ligama lekugcina, njengo “Umuntfu ngumuntfu nga___”. Chayani sikhetho noma khombisa siphetso, bese nikhuluma ngakho.
finish-the-saying.short: Phetsani tinkhulumo letijwayelekile ndzawonye, bese nikhuluma ngato.
finish-the-saying.intro: Tinkhulumo letindala tivame kwatiwa iminyaka yonkhe. Ikhadi ngalinye likhombisa inkhulumo lejwayelekile lelishoda ligama lekugcina, tikhetso letintsatfu, nenkinobho “Khombisa siphetso”. Ngemuva kwesiphetso, umbuto lomnandzi uvulela kuxoxa.
howTo: Fundani inkhulumo ngekuphimisa ndzawonye.
Chayani ligama lelitfola lokuphetsa, noma chayani “Khombisa siphetso”.
Fundani inkhulumo lenkhulu futsi nikhuluma ngayo nisebentisa umbuto.
Chayani “Lelandzelako” lapho nilungele.
tips: Fundani kancane futsi nimise kancane ngaphambi kweligama lekugcina. Kuvame kutsi bantfu batsi lisho ngaphambi kwekutsi uliphetse.
Uma umuntfu anikela siphetso lesihlukile, nikujabulele. Tinkhulumo letinye tiyahluka ngemndeni noma ngendzawo.
Uma niliqembu, umuntfu mnye afundza bese bonkhe bajoyina ekuphetseni.

word-search.name: Umdlalo wemagama lamakhulu
word-search.seoTitle: Kufuna Emagama Ngetinhlamvu Letikhulu, Mahhala Futsi Lingashicilelwa
word-search.description: Umdlalo wekufuna emagama lomahhala ngetinhlamvu letikhulu wabantfu labadzala nemindeni. Emagama lambalwa, tinhlamvu letikhulu, emagama aya ngakubo kuphela futsi aya ngaphansi. Dlala ku-inthanethi noma ushicilele.
word-search.short: Tinhlamvu letikhulu, emagama ambalwa, ahamba ngecala nangaphansi kuphela. Uyawuphrinta futsi.
word-search.intro: Ligrid lelincane netinhlamvu letikhulu nemagama ambalwa, onkhe afundeka ngecala noma ngaphansi. Thinta inhlamvu yekucala yelivi, bese uthinta leyekugcina. Ukhetsa iphepha? Uphrinte luhla oluhlakile ngekucindzetela kunye.
howTo: Khetha indzikinyo nobukhulu begridi.
Bukisisa luhla lwemagama. Emagama afundeka ngecala (kusuka ngesobunxele kuya ngesokudla) noma ngaphansi (kusuka phezulu kuya phansi).
Thinta inhlamvu yekucala yelivi, bese uthinta leyekugcina.
Livi lelitfoliwe liyagcotjwa futsi liyacolwa ohlwini.
Thinta "Phrinta lomdlalo" uze udlale ngephepha nangepeni noma ngemakhalamu.
tips: Khombisa livi ohlwini uyibukisise inhlamvu yalo yekucala ndzawonye.
Ephepheni, umakhalamu wekukhanyisa ulula kubambeka kunepeni.
Khuluma ngemagama alendzikinyo. Emagama etitselo ayindlela lenhle yekuya etinkhumbulweni tekukhetsa, kubhaka nasemakethe.

Yebo. Thinta "Phrinta lomdlalo" uphrinte ligrid lamanje ngetinhlamvu letikhulu, nluhla lwemagama ngaphansi kwalo. Lomdlalo ngamunye lomusha uhlukile.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi alikho akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Kuyasebenta kwibhrawuza yewebhu efonini, ethebulethini noma ekhompyutheni.

coloring.name: Emaphepha ekudaya
coloring.seoTitle: Emakhasi Ekudaya Lamahhala Wabantfu Labadzala, Makhulu Futsi Lulula
coloring.description: Emaphepha ekudaya labadzala, lalula, anetindzawo letikhulu: thinta umbala, bese uthinta sitfombe. Akukho kuhlanta, akukho mibala lephosile, futsi lilphepha ngalinye lingaphrintwa mahhala.
coloring.short: Thinta umbala, bese uthinta lencenye yesitfombe. Uyawuphrinta emaphepha futsi.
coloring.intro: Emaphepha anemimumo lemikhulu lelulalula: lilumbu esitsiyeni, indlu, inkomishi yetiyi, libhabhathane nelibhothi lelisebenta ngemoya. Thinta umbala, bese uthinta incenye yesitfombe ukuze uyigcwalise. Akukho mibala lephosile.
howTo: Khetha liphepha.
Thinta umbala. Umbala ngamunye unelibito lawo lelibhalwe kuwo.
Thinta incenye yesitfombe ukuze uyigcwalise ngalowo mbala.
Ungashintja umcabango nanoma nini ngekugcwalisa kabusha.
Thinta "Phrinta leliphepha" uze utfole liphepha lelingenalutfo lokudaya ngemapensela noma ngemakhalamu.
tips: Nika imibala lemibili yekukhetsa esikhundleni sesethi lephelele uma kukhetsa kukhanya kakhulu.
Tihlahla letibovu netilanga letiluhlaza ayemukelekile. Lokubalulekile kujabula ngemibala, hhayi kuba lichaneko.
Emaphepha laphrintiwe asebenta kahle nemakhalamu lamakhulu noma tinkhwishi, letilula kubambeka.

faq.a: Cha. Alikho iwashi, umphumela, sibalo semanyatselo noma kulahlekelwa. Ungayeka nanoma nini, futsi kuyeka uhhafu kuyindlela lenhle yekuphetsa.
Sidzwe sitfombe letisibekelo letiyatuliseka, hhayi emahlaya. Imifanekiso lemikhulu yenta kudaya kube lula kodvwa kungabi ngekwebantfwana.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi alikho akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Kuyasebenta kwibhrawuza yewebhu efonini, ethebulethini noma ekhompyutheni.

conversation-cards.name: Emakhadi ekuxoxisana
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Mazinkulumo Tinkhadi Tetingcoco: Tikhadi Tetincoco Telemindeni
conversation-cards.description: Tikhadi letinetinkhulumisano letingotsi temindeni, bangani kanye nebantfu labadzala, kubandlula kubo bantfu labaphila nesifo sekukhohlwa. Kute kuhlolwa, kute timphendvulo letilungile.
conversation-cards.short: Emakhadi etifanekiso anemibuto lemnene leyivulekile. Akukho kuhlola.
conversation-cards.intro: Likhadi ngalinye linesitfombe lesaziwako nesimemo lesivulekile sekukhuluma, njenga kutsi "Yiluphi luhlobo lwemoya olutsandza kakhulu?" Akukho timphendvulo letilungile futsi akukho lokufanele ukukhumbula. Khetsa indzikinyo noma xuba konkhe.
howTo: Khetsa indzikinyo, noma gcina "Emakhadi onkhe".
Funda umbuto ngelizwi lelikhulu ubukisise sitfombe ndzawonye.
Lalela, wabelane ngemphendvulo yakho, uvumele kukhuluma kuhambe kahle.
Thinta "Likhadi lelilandzelako" uma usulungile, noma uhlale nelikhadi linye njengoba unesikhatsi lesidzingekako.
Thinta "Phrinta emakhadi onkhe" uwasike ukuze ube nesethi yephepha.
tips: Phendvula umbuto nawe. Kuzwakala njengekuxoxisana, hhayi kubuvisisa.
Landzela indzaba, hhayi tiniqiniso. Uma tincenye tishintja, lokwenteka kuhle.
Uma likhadi linyatsela nentfo lebuhlungu, vuma umuzwa bese uyashintja ngobumnene uye kelinye likhadi.

faq.a: Imibuto lehlola inkhumbulo ingazwakala njengemvivinyo futsi ibangele ihlazo. Timemo letivulekile njenga "Ngitjele ngalokuthi…" tivumela noma ngubani kutfola ingxenye, nanoma angakhumbula kangakanani.
Yebo. "Phrinta emakhadi onkhe" uphrinta sethi lephelele ngetinhlamvu letikhulu, emakhadi lamaningi ekhasini ngalinye, ilungele kusikwa.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi akudzingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Iyasebenta ebhrawuzeni yewebhu ku-foni, ku-thebhulethi noma ku-khompyutha.

photo-pairs.name: Tibhangqwana tetifanekiso
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Yenta Umdlalo Wekuhlanganisa Tibhangqwana Ngetifanekiso Temndeni
photo-pairs.description: Guca tifanekiso takho temndeni tibe ngumdlalo lowucolisekile wekuhlanganisa. Khetsa tifanekiso letimbili kuya kwetisithupha ku-foni, ku-thebhulethi noma ku-khompyutha yakho; tihlala ebhrawuzeni yakho futsi kute tidluliselwe kunoma ngubani.
photo-pairs.short: Khetsa tifanekiso takho uzihlanganise. Kute lokulayishwa.
photo-pairs.intro: Khetsa tiphiko letimbili kuya kutsi letisitfupha takho tetindlu takho kusuka ku-foni yakho, ku-tablet noma ku-khompiyutha, bese tiba lilokudlala lekulingana nemifanekiso lemikhulu lebonakalako. Tifanekiso tibonakala kuphela kulelikhasi. Atitfolakali, atigcinwa, futsi atabelwani, bese tinyamalala nakavalwa likhasi. Uma utsandza, engeta emagama lambalwa ngaphansi kwesifanekiso ngasinye, kanti sikhombisi lesimnyane singakhombisa lebhange lilinye ngemuva kwesikhashana. Lelivelo lingumkhuba wekubukana emifanekisweni yemindeni ndzawonye.
howTo: Tinta "Khetsa tifanekiso" bese ukhetsa tifanekiso letimbili kuya kutsi letisitfupha.
Ngasinye sesifanekiso sivela kabili. Tinta esinye, bese utinta lesilingene naso.
Uma utsandza, engeta emagama lambalwa ngaphansi kwesifanekiso ngasinye. Emagama agcinwa.
Khuluma ngesifanekiso ngasinye njengoba ukutfola.
Nawuphelile, valela likhasi noma tinta "Sula tifanekiso". Akukho lokugcinwako.
tips: Khetsa tifanekiso letisobala letinemajabulo netitsandzekako: silwane sasekhaya, sivande, indzawo lotsandzako, lilanga lemshado.
Tifanekiso tetindzawo netintfo tingaba lula kunebantfu, futsi akukho kucindzetelwa kutsi kusho emagama emabito.
Shiya tifanekiso tebantfu labashonile uma vebangase bavuse kudzabuka kwemanyenta, ngaphandle kwekutsi uyati kutsi tiletula induduzo.

faq.q: Tifanekiso takho itilayishelwa kunoma kuphi yini?
faq.a: Cha. Likhasi lifundza tifanekiso letikhetsako ngqo ebhrawuzeni yakho futsi litibonisa esikrinini sakho. Atidluliselwa kithi noma kunoma ngubani lokunye, futsi ayanyamalala uma uvala noma uvuselela likhasi.
Cha. Kute lotimela sikhatsi, umphumela, lokubalwa kwetinyatselo noma kulahlekelwa. Ungamisa nanoma nini, futsi kumisa uhhafu kuyindlela lenhle yekuphetfa.
Hhayi ebhrawuzeni, ngemabomu, kuze kungagcinwa lutfo lwemuntfu. I-app ye-Creative Activities yeyi-iPhone ne-iPad lehlala mahhala ingagcina tikhopi tetifanekiso letikhetsiwe esilwaneni sakho.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo yetifanekiso
picture-bingo.description: Bingo yemifanekiso lemahhala lenganyatselwa yemindeni, emaqembuebantfu abadzala kanye nemakhaya ekunakekela. Tifanekiso letikhulu nemagama, emabhokisi angu-9 noma angu-16, kanye nomcengi lomkhulu lobonakala esikrini.
picture-bingo.short: Emakhadi ebingo yetifanekiso lasiphrintwako nelimemezeli lelikhulu lamaqembu.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo lendlala ngetifanekiso esikhundleni semanombolo, kuze kungabi nalowodzingeka kufundza tincwadzi letincane. Phrinta sheti yemakhadi lahlukile, bese usebentisa limemezeli lesikrinini kuze kubonakale ngalinye lifanekiso likhulu ku-TV, ku-laptop noma ku-thebhulethi.
howTo: Khetsa emasikwele angu-9 noma angu-16 ekhadini ngalinye, nekutsi bangaki badlali.
Thinta "Phrinta emakhadi". Likhadi ngalinye liyahlukana.
Vula limemezeli esikrinini lesikhulu. Thinta "Lifanekiso lelilandzelako" kuze kubonakale ngalinye lifanekiso nelibito laso.
Badlali bagubha lifanekiso lelifanako ekhadini labo ngelitfutfu, inkinobho noma imakhalekhi.
Lilinye nalilinye lomuntfu lagcwalisa umugca, noma likhadi lonkhe, litfola kubongwa. Kute labahlulekako kuleli dlalo: qhubeka nekudlala kuze kube nalomunye umugca.
tips: Sebentisa tintfo letikhulu njengetintfwala temadamu noma tinkhwebu temabhodlela. Tinkinobho letincane tingaba nzima kutfola.
Tibite lifanekiso bese utsi lilusha ngaloyo lifanekiso: "Sikhephe. Ngubani lowake wahamba ngemkhephe?"
Hlala bantfu labakhubatekako kutfola kahle ngakufaka eduzane nesikrini, futsi uhlanganise abasekeli nebadlali labadzinga lusito.
Emasikwele lasheshumane ayanele emaqembu lamaningi. Gcina sikhatsi semdlalo cishe ngemaminithi lamashumi amabili kuya kulamashumi amatsatfu.

faq.q: Ngidlala kanjani bingo yetifanekiso endlini yekunakekela?
faq.a: Phrinta likhadi lilinye ngemdlali ngamunye, faka limemezeli esikrinini lesikhulu lolitfolako, bese ubita tifanekiso kancane, ubite ngalinye ngelibito lalo. Dlala kuze kube nalomunye umugca, kute umuntfu asalele ngaphandle.
Yebo. Phrinta emakhadi lolwadzingako, nalokuphindzaphindzeka lofunako, kusetjentiselwa kwemuntfu nje noma kweliqembu.
Yebo. Lilinye nalilinye sikwele lilifanekiso lelikhulu, nelibito lalo ngaphansi kwalo kulabo labatsandza emagama.

picnic-planner.name: Lirhuluhhoyi lephikhnikhi
picnic-planner.h1: Lirhuluhhoyi Lephikhnikhi: Khetsa Tifanekiso, Bese Tilinganisa
picnic-planner.description: Khetsa tifanekiso tekudla netintfo lekwentelwako ephikhnikhini, bese udlala umdlalo lolula wekulingana netifanekiso Itfo. Akukho sikhatsi lesibalwako. Kuyamahhala kudlala nekuprinta.
picnic-planner.short: Khetsa tifanekiso tekudla netelulendzabuko ephikhnikhini, bese tiyalingana.
picnic-planner.intro: Tinta tifanekiso tekudla netintfo lekwentelwako ukuze utifake ebhasikidi lephikhnikhi, lelisiphatsa tifanekiso letisitfupha. Umusho ngemagama uchaza lokusebhasikidini, njengo-"Iphikhnikhi lethu: sinkwa, shizi, tiapula nesigubhu." Bese utinta "Asidlale ngephikhnikhi lethu" ukuze kube nemdlalo lolula wekulingana ngetifanekiso letikhetsiwe. Tifanekiso tiyahlala tibonakala, futsi akukho sikhatsi, emaphuzu noma kugcinwa lokwentiwako. "Printa luhlu lwephikhnikhi lethu" iprinta lishadi lekuhlola lalokukhetsiwe, nelibhokisi lekutiketa ngalinye lekupakishwa.
howTo: Tinta sifanekiso sekudla noma sintfo lekwentelwako. Siyongena ebhasikidini.
Tinta sifanekiso lusebhasikidini ukuze usikhiphe futsi.
Khetsa tintfo letingenani letimbili, bese utinta "Asidlale ngephikhnikhi lethu".
Tinta tifanekiso letimbili letilingene. Tifanekiso tiyahlala tibonakala, kute lesidzingeka sikhumbule.
Tinta "Printa luhlu lwephikhnikhi lethu" ukuze uthole lishadi lelibhalwe ephepheni lokuhamba nalo.
tips: Buta bantfu lobahamba nabo ukuthi bafisa kuletsa tini, bese nikhetsa tifanekiso ndzawonye.
Khuluma ngesifanekiso ngasinye njengoba singena: "Uyayikhumbula yini indlovu yekhayithi lesiyibambe elwandle?"
Ephepheni, emugca lovulekile yilabo ngetintfo letinye lofuna kuletsa, noma yelibito.

faq.q: Kukhona sikhatsi, emaphuzu noma umuntfu lowinako yini?
faq.a: Cha. Akukho sikhatsi lesibalwako noma kubalwa lutfo, futsi akukho lowinako. Umdlalo wekulingana awunalo liphutsa noma emaphuzu.
Cha. Kuhleleka kwetifanekiso kwelulendzabuko, kutsi kukhulume ngako futsi kuphrintwe kuphepha. Akutjelisi kutsi umuntfu udla ini.

faq.q: Tifanekiso lesitikhetsako tiyagcinwa noma tiyatfunyelwa yini?
faq.a: Cha. Bhasikidi lihlala kulelikhasi kuphela. Ayigcinwa, ayilayishwa, futsi ayitfunyelwa, futsi iyanyamalala nakavalwa likhasi.
Yebo. "Printa luhlu lwephikhnikhi lethu" iprinta likhasi linye, ku-A4 noma ku-US Letter. Likhombisa tifanekiso letikhetsiwe nebhokisi lekutiketa ngalinye, kanye nemugca lovulekile wanoma yini lenye.
Yebo, ayihhala, futsi akudzingekii-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Iyasebenta ku-web browser ku-foni, ku-tablet noma ku-khompiyutha.

scrapbook.name: Incwadi yetinkhumbulo
scrapbook.seoTitle: Incwadi Yetinkhumbulo: Phendvula Tifanekiso Temindeni Ndzawonye, Lilphepha Ngalinye
scrapbook.h1: Incwadi Yetinkhumbulo: Engeta Tifanekiso Takho Namagama, Bese Uphendvula Emaphepha
scrapbook.description: Khetsa tifanekiso letimbili kuya kutsi letilitfoti letilishumi nembili temindeni takho esitfokotfeni sakho, uphendvule njengencwadi, nemagama lambalwa ngaphansi kwalilinye. Akukho lolayishwako. Kuyamahhala kuprinta.
scrapbook.short: Hlola tifanekiso temindeni takho ndzawonye, njengencwadi.
scrapbook.intro: Khetsa tifanekiso letimbili kuya kutsi letilitfoti letilishumi nembili takho kusuka kulesitfokotfeni. Sifanekiso ngasinye siba likhasi linye lencwadi, likhulu kutsi siboneke, nemagama lambalwa lakhetelekako ngaphansi kwaso. Phendvula emaphepha ngetinkinobho noma ngetinkinobho temitsi. Sebenta "Bukani ndzawonye" ukuze nihlale ecedvuke nibuke tifanekiso nemagama kuphela. Tifanekiso takho tihlala kulesitfokotfeni. Atilayishwa, atigcinwa, futsi incwadi iyanyamalala nakavalwa likhasi. "Printa incwadi yetinkhumbulo" iprinta sifanekiso sinye nemagama aso likhasi ngalinye, netinombolo tematsamo.
howTo: Tinta "Khetsa tifanekiso" bese ukhetsa tifanekiso letimbili kuya kutsi letilitfoti letilishumi nembili. Buta kucela nawuya kusebentisa sifanekiso sawo umuntfu longakwazi kuvuma.
Phendvula emaphepheni ngo-"Likhasi langaphambili" kanye no-"Likhasi lelilandzelako", noma ngetinkinobho lelicondvu netsi lelilunqinti.
Engeta emagama lambalwa ngaphansi kwesifanekiso uma utsandza. Sebenta "Hambisa kwangaphambili" noma "Hambisa kwemuva" uchinteke lilandzelelo.
Tinta "Bukani ndzawonye" ukuze ufiche tilawuli tekuhlela, bese nibuka incwadi nicedvuke.
Tinta "Printa incwadi yetinkhumbulo" ukuze uthole likhophi lephepha, noma "Sula incwadi" nawuphelile. Akukho lokugcinwako.
tips: Vyber fotky šťastných a známých věcí: zahrada, zvíře, oblíbené místo. Při každém listování si o stránce popovídejte.
Nech člověka říct několik slov ke každé stránce, i jen jedno slovo, a zapiš je přesně tak, jak je řekne.
Na papíře se vytištěné stránky dají založit do složky a rodina kolem nich může přidat vlastní fotky a poznámky.

faq.q: Je tu časomíra, bodování nebo vítěz?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or counted, and nobody wins. The page number is only there so you know where you are in the book.

faq.q: Ukládají se naše fotky nebo popisky, nahrávají se nebo odesílají?
faq.a: Ne. Fotky čte jen tato stránka, nenahrávají se, neukládají a nikam se neodesílají. Popisky se uchovávají jen po dobu, kdy je stránka otevřená. Když stránku zavřete, kniha zmizí.
Ano. Tlačítko „Vytisknout album“ vytiskne na každou stránku jednu fotku a její popisek, s čísly stránek. V tiskovém dialogu zvolte formát A4 nebo US Letter.

faq.q: Je to zdarma a musím se registrovat?
faq.a: Ano, je to zdarma a není potřeba účet, registrace ani stahování. Funguje ve webovém prohlížeči v telefonu, tabletu nebo počítači.

collage-board.name: Kolážová tabule
collage-board.seoTitle: Kolážová tabule: Dva lidé střídavě kladou obrázky
collage-board.h1: Kolážová tabule: Kladení obrázků na jednu tabuli, střídavě
collage-board.description: Dva lidé střídavě kladou vystřižené obrázky na jednu společnou tabuli. Klepněte na výstřižek a potom na prázdné místo. Bez časomíry a bodů. Hra i tisk jsou zdarma.
collage-board.short: Střídavě kladte obrázky na jednu společnou tabuli.
collage-board.intro: Two people sit side by side with one board of twelve places and a tray of eight cut-out pictures. Tap a cut-out, then tap an empty place, and the picture goes there. The turn then passes to the other person. Each person's pictures carry their own shape, a circle or a square, so the board shows who placed what without relying on color. Either person may pass, and one step can be taken back. Nothing is timed, scored or saved. "Print the board" prints the empty board and the pictures to cut out.
howTo: Klepněte na výstřižek v zásobníku. Během výběru se zobrazí „Vybráno“.
Klepněte na prázdné místo na tabuli. Výstřižek se tam položí a tah přechází.
Kdokoli z vás může kdykoli klepnout na Předat, nebo na „Vzít zpět poslední kus“ a vrátit jeden krok.
Klepněte na „Další sada obrázků“ pro jiný zásobník. Obrázky, které už jsou na tabuli, zůstanou, kde jsou.
Klepněte na „Začít znovu“ a tabule se vyprázdní. Pokud si to rozmyslíte, použijte „Vrátit zpět“.
tips: Při každém položeném obrázku řekněte jeho název, například „šálek čaje jde k domu“. Mluvení z toho dělá společnou činnost.
Nechte oba lidi střídavě vybírat výstřižek i místo, aby měl každý co říct.
Na papíře vystřihněte osm obrázků za pomoci dospělého a potom je položte na vytištěná políčka.

faq.q: Je tu časomíra, bodování nebo vítěz?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or counted, and nobody wins. A full board is simply one with a picture in every place.

faq.q: Ukládají nebo odesílají se obrázky, které položíme?
faq.a: Ne. Tabule zůstává jen na této stránce. Neukládá se, nenahrává a nepočítá se a po zavření stránky zmizí.

faq.q: Jak poznáme, čí je který obrázek?
faq.a: Každý člověk má svůj tvar. Obrázky prvního člověka mají v rohu kruh, obrázky druhého čtverec, a nad tabulí je vidět jméno každého z nich.
Ano. „Vytisknout tabuli“ vytiskne prázdnou tabuli jako dvanáct políček, pod ní osm obrázků ve stejné velikosti a čáry pro střih. Stříhat může dospělý.

faq.q: Je to zdarma a musím se registrovat?
faq.a: Ano, je to zdarma a není potřeba účet, registrace ani stahování. Funguje ve webovém prohlížeči v telefonu, tabletu nebo počítači.

garden-planner.name: Plánovač zahrady
garden-planner.seoTitle: Plánovač zahrady: Rozložení záhonu z obrázků rostlin
garden-planner.h1: Plánovač zahrady: Vyberte obrázky a rozložte záhon
garden-planner.description: Vyberte obrázky rostlin a zahradních věcí a položte je do dvanácti záhonů. Klepněte na obrázek a potom na záhon. Bez časomíry a bodů. Hra i tisk jsou zdarma.
garden-planner.short: Vyberte obrázky rostlin a rozložte záhon o dvanácti záhonech.
garden-planner.intro: Choose pictures from a tray of plants and garden things, then tap a bed to put each one in place. A plot has twelve beds, and a bed holds one picture. A summary in words says what the plan has, such as "Your plan has 3 sunflowers, 2 roses and 1 tree." Nothing is timed, scored or saved, and there are no turns. This is a picture plan to talk about, not planting advice. "Print the plan" prints the beds with the pictures you chose, with blank beds to draw in and lines for notes.
howTo: Klepněte na obrázek v zásobníku. Během výběru se zobrazí „Vybráno“.
Klepněte na záhon. Obrázek se tam položí a výběr je uložen.
Chcete-li záhon změnit, vyberte jiný obrázek a klepněte na záhon. Chcete-li záhon vyprázdnit, klepněte na něj, když není vybrán žádný obrázek.
Klepněte na „Začít znovu“ a vyprázdní se všechny záhony. Pokud si to rozmyslíte, použijte „Vrátit zpět“.
Klepněte na „Vytisknout plán“ a dostanete papírovou kopii záhonu a shrnutí.
tips: Talk about each picture as it goes in, such as "sunflower iyoma endzaleni lenembili". Kukhuluma kuyenta umsebenti lowabelwana ngawo.
Vumela umuntu ngamunye akhetse isithombe ngesikhatsi sakhe, noma nikhetse emasithombe ndzawonye, ukuze bobabili banelisekile ekuhleleni kwelicebo.
Ephepheni, emabhedi lamhlophe angetfelwa emcabango wakho, kanti emigca yemanothi yemihlahlandlela yanoma yini ofuna kuyikhumbula.

Yebo, ayikhokhelwa, futsi akudzingeki i-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulayisha. Isebenta kusiphequluli sewebhu kuselifoni, kuthebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

coloring-wall.name: Group coloring wall
coloring-wall.seoTitle: Group Coloring Wall: One Picture for Many Hands
coloring-wall.h1: Group Coloring Wall: One Big Picture, Colored Together
coloring-wall.description: Print one large picture across several pages, so a family, a class or a care home can color one wall together. Free to print. No timer or score.
coloring-wall.short: Print one big picture across pages for many people to color.
coloring-wall.players: A group, at a table or on a wall
coloring-wall.intro: Choose a picture from the coloring pages and a wall of 4, 6 or 9 pages. Print the wall: the first page shows how to put it together, and each of the other pages is one part of the same big picture, with a label such as A1 in its corner. Each person colors one or more pages, in any colors and any style. The pages are then laid out by their labels and joined with tape on the back. Nothing is timed, scored or saved.
howTo: Choose a picture, then choose how many pages the wall has.
Read the map on the screen, which shows where each label goes.
Tap "Print the wall" and print all the pages.
Give each person one or more pages to color. Colors and styles do not need to match.
Lay the pages out by their labels, and join them with tape on the back.
tips: Give the pages with the simplest outlines to the people who want a quieter task, and the busier ones to anyone who enjoys them.
Hang the wall where everyone can see it, and talk about the parts together.
Choose a smaller wall for a small table, and a bigger one for a room.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho lokusikhathalelwa, lokufakelwa emaphuzu noma lokubalwa, futsi akukho lowaphumelelako. Lidvwodvwo ludzonga lolutsi lemifanekiso lebhalwe ngabantfu labanyenti.

faq.q: Ingabe emakhasi atfolakala noma atfunyelwa ndzawo?

Cha. Umuntu ngamunye angasebentisa emabala lanoma yiphi indlela. Emakhasi asakwati kuhlanganiseka abe sifanekiso sinye.
Yebo. Lidvwodvwo leliphrintiwe ngumdlalo lonkhe: likhasi lekucala lelinetinyatselo nemephu, nelikhasi linye ngalinye lesigaba sesifanekiso.
Yebo, ayikhokhelwa, futsi akudzingeki i-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulayisha. Isebenta kusiphequluli sewebhu kuselifoni, kuthebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

quiet-shapes.name: Quiet shapes puzzle
quiet-shapes.seoTitle: Quiet Shapes Puzzle: Fit Shapes Into a Picture
quiet-shapes.h1: Quiet Shapes Puzzle: Fit the Pieces into the Picture
quiet-shapes.description: Fit simple shapes into the outline of a house, a boat, a fish and more. Tap a piece, then a space of the same shape. There is no timer or score. Free to play and print.
quiet-shapes.short: Fit simple shapes into a picture, at your own pace.
quiet-shapes.intro: A picture outline, such as a house, a boat or a rocket, is divided into spaces. Each space has a piece of the same shape, a large or small triangle, a square, a parallelogram or a rectangle. Tap a piece, then tap a space of the same shape, and it fits. The space turns the piece for you, so there is nothing to drag or rotate. If a piece is a different shape from a space, it stays in the tray with a short note. Nothing is timed or scored, and nothing is saved or sent. "Print this shape" prints the outline and its pieces on one page to color or cut out.
howTo: Tap a piece in the tray. It shows "Chosen" while it is selected.
Tap a space in the picture. If the shape matches, the piece fits there.
If it does not match, try another space. Nothing is lost by trying.
Tap a piece in the picture to take it back to the tray, or use "Start again" to take all of them back.
When every space has its piece, the picture is complete. Tap "Another shape" for a new one, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Fanya imikhakha ibonakale ngekutsi uvule tintfo letikhombisa indzawo ngayinye. Yivale uma ufuna umdlalo lolunzima, lapho ulanda imphendvulo yemugca wekuphela.
Qala ngemikhakha lemikhulu, njengetincincilili letikhulu nemacalaka. Tintfo letincane titfola ngemuva kwato tonkhe.
Tsi tibite emagama lapho uhamba khona: "litriangle, sikwele, licalaka lelide". Kukhuluma kungenta lomdlalo abe senchubo yekuhlanganyela.
Ephepheni, phenta tintfo ngemibala lemibili noma lemitsatfu, noma sikere, nencusa lesekela umdzala.

faq.q: Ingabe kukhona sikhatsi, umphumela noma kubalwa kwetinyatselo?
faq.a: Cha. Akukho lokubalwa, sikhatsi noma umphumela. Intfo lengafaneleki ayibekwa, futsi ungayeka noma nini lapho ufuna khona.

faq.q: Ingabe lokusitakwe kwenta kuyagcinwa noma kutfunyelwa?
faq.a: Cha. Sitfombe sihlala kulelikhasi kuphela. Asigcinwa, asifakwa noma asibalwa, futsi siyanyamalala uma uvala likhasi.

faq.q: Ingabe tindzawo tikhulu kakhulu kangangekutsi tingasetfwa ngulesandla lesidzedzelekako noma kusikrini lesincane?
faq.a: Umhlahlandlela udzwetfwe lilingana nesikrini lesingakufinyelela, futsi ngayinye indzawo iyinkinobho lotsi ingayifinyelela ngemunwe noma ngekhi-Tab. Tintfo lusibheno lwetinkhinobho letikhulu lekhasi.

Yebo. "Phrinta lesimo" iphrinta sitfombe sinye ephepheni linye: umhlahlandlela nemigca yawo yetiyaleliso, netintfo letidwetfwe ngobukhulu bulinye ecedze wona. Phenta tintfo, noma uzisike zifanele. Umdzala angasika.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi akunayo i-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Isebenta kusiphequluli se-web kulifoni, ithebulethi noma likhompyutha.

calm-breathing.name: Kuphefumula kancane
calm-breathing.description: Sikhashana sekuphefumula ngekutsula nekwabelana ngaso: sekela lelihle likhula lisincipha kweSitfupha semaphefumulo. Wena uyacala, futsi ungayeka nanoma nini.
calm-breathing.short: Sekela lelicondvwako lekuphefumula kulo. Cala futsi uyeke nawuthanda.
calm-breathing.intro: Ngalesinye sikhatsi umsebenti lolungile kakhulu sikhashana lesitfutfukile. Thinta "Cala", bese uphefumula sekela likhula, uphume lisincipha. Khetsa isivinini lesishesha noma lesikhashana. Akusikwelashwa, kodvwa sikhashana lesitfula lekwabelana ngaso.
howTo: Hlala ngekutfula eduzane nalomunye.
Khetsa isivinini: sikhashana noma sincane.
Thinta "Cala". Phefumula ngesikhatsi sekhula, uphume ngesikhatsi sincipha.
Iyayeka yodvwa emaphefumulweni lasitfupha, noma thinta "Yeka" nanoma nini ulandzela.
tips: Bambatane tandla noma ubeke sandla emkhonweni wemuntfu uma lokho kwamukelwa.
Ungaphikisi. Uma bafisa kubukela kuphela, kulungile.
Uma umuntfu anenkinga yekuphefumula, phefumula ngendlela yekujwayelekile ubukele sekela kuphela. Buta kudokotela ngalokuphathelene nanoma yiphi inkinga yekuphefumula.

faq.a: Cha. Ngusikhashana lelula, lelikhetsekako sekutfula nekuba nemunye. Akusiyo indlela yekwelapha kukhatsateka noma sifo nanoma yini. Khuluma nedokotela ngetinkinga temphilo.

faq.q: Ingabe sekela liyanyakaza ngaphandle kokuba ngiqale yini?
faq.a: Cha. Akukho lenyakazako kuze ucindzetele i-Start, futsi iyayeka ngemuva kwemaphefumulo lasitfupha noma uma ucindzetela i-Stop. Uma lidivayisi yakho ilungiselelwe kunciphisa kunyakaza, emagama ayashintjwa kodvwa lijikijela alikhuli.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi akudzingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma kulanda lutfo. Kusebenta esiphequluli sewebhu kufoni, kulithebulethi noma kukhompyutha.

story-chain.name: Ketani yendaba
story-chain.seoTitle: Ketani Yendaba: Umdlalo Wendaba Yetitfombe Lokwabelanwa
story-chain.h1: Ketani Yendaba: Khuluma Indaba Sitfombe Ngasinye Ngesikhatsi
story-chain.description: Umugca wetitfombe ukhula sitfombe sinye ngesikhatsi, futsi umuntfu ngamunye utsi umusho mabili ngaso ngelizwi lelikhulu. Akukho lokubhalwa, akukho mphendvulo lefanele. Mahhala, kuthulile, ngaphandle kwesikhatsi nemphumela.
story-chain.short: Engeza sitfombe, bese umuntfu ngamunye utsi umusho, njengobe nishintshana.
story-chain.intro: Umdlalo uyaqala ngesitfombe sinye bese ukhula ketani sitfombe ngasinye ngesikhatsi. Umuntfu ngamunye utsi umusho munye ngaketani lesesikhona, ngelizwi lelikhulu, ngekushintshana. Umusho ungaba ngalokubonakala, indzawo lekhumbula, noma intfo lehlekisako. Akukho lokubhalwa, lokurekhodwa noma lokugcinwa, akukho mphendvulo lefanele, futsi noyiphi umuntfu angadlulisa. Ketani iyema ngetitfombe letisi-8, bese ungaqala lenye.
howTo: Bukani sitfombe lesihlala kuqala ndzawonye.
Nishintshane: umuntfu ngamunye utsi umusho munye ngaketani lesesikhona. Noyiphi umuntfu angadlulisa.
Tfwesa "Engeza sitfombe" kute sitfombe lesilandzelako sibekwe ekugcineni kweketani.
Tfwesa "Susa lesikugcina" uma ungafuna kuphindza emuva sitfombe sinye.
Ketani ine-titfombe letisi-8 uma sesifikile, tfwesa "Qala ketani lensha" ngeketani lensha, noma yeka nje.
tips: Lofusha kuyalungiswa: "Umuntfu ubeke umbila wetiyanga." Umuntfu lolandzelako uyaqhubeka, noma adlulise.
Vumela titfombe tikhombise indlela. Akukho indaba lekufanele ufike kuyo.
Yeka noma nini lapho ufuna khona. Kuyeka losikhatsini lophakathi kuyindlela lenhle yekuphetsa.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho ikhloki, umphumela, kubalwa kwetinyatselo noma kulahlekelwa. Ungayeka nanoma nini, futsi kuyeka losikhatsini lophakathi kuyindlela lenhle yekuphetsa.
Cha. Imisho icinyiwe ngelizwi lelikhulu futsi ayibhalwa, ayirekhodwa noma ayatfunyelwa ndzawo. Umdlalo ukhombisa titfombe kuphela.

faq.q: Kuyini uma umuntfu lingafuni kutsi tintfo?

Yebo, kuyamahhala, futsi akunayo i-akhawunti, kubhalisa noma kulanda. Isebenta kusiphequluli se-web kulifoni, ithebulethi noma likhompyutha.

quiet-scene.name: Sitfombe lesikhutsulako
quiet-scene.h1: Sitfombe Lesikhutsulako: Sitfombe Sinye Lesimile Ngesikhatsi
quiet-scene.description: Sitfombe sinye lesikhulu lesimile ngesikhatsi, ngasinye nemugca munye lolusibekela kancane ngaphansi. Cindzetela Lokulandzelako noma Lokwangaphambili uma usulungele. Akukho lonyakazako noma lodlala ngekwakhe, futsi akukho sikhatsi noma umphumela. Kuyamahhala kudlalwa, ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti.
quiet-scene.short: Bukisisa sitfombe sinye lesimile ngesikhatsi, ngesivinini sakho.
quiet-scene.intro: Sitfombe lesikhulu sinye sigcwalisa sikrini, nemugca lomfishane ngaphansi kwaso. Cindzetela "Sitfombe lesilandzelako" noma "Sitfombe lesingaphambili" uma usulungele lesinye. Akukho lonyakazako, lonyamalalako noma lotshintjako ngekwakhe, futsi akukho sikhatsi lesibalwako. Tfwesa "Sitfombe lesikhulu" kute kutfole sitfombe kuphela, kuze lonkhe lilungu lekamelo litfole kubona etelevishini.
howTo: Bukani sitfombe ndzawonye.
Fundza umugca lusibekela ngaphansi ngelizwi lelikhulu uma uyatsandza.
Cindzetela "Sitfombe lesilandzelako" noma "Sitfombe lesingaphambili" uma usulungele.
Tfwesa "Sitfombe lesikhulu" kute kutfole sitfombe kuphela, na "Kutfole konkhe" kute kubuyisele lokunye.
Yeka noma nini lapho ufuna khona ngo"Sekwanele kwalesikhatsi".
tips: Vumela umuntfu akhetse lapho afuna khona kuya lapho lilandzelako: lindzela kuze abukise, bese ucindzetela Lokulandzelako.
Kuze kube liqembu, sebentisa "Sitfombe lesikhulu" etelevishini noma kusikrini lesikhulu futsi uhlale lapho onkhe bakwati khona kubona.
Akukho indlela lefanele yekubukisisa sitfombe. Kukhuluma nje ngaso kuyinchubo lephelele.

color-wash.name: Ukugeza ngemibala
color-wash.seoTitle: Ukugeza ngemibala: Umbala lombiti kulo lonkhe ludzaba
color-wash.h1: Ukugeza ngemibala: Pendvula umbala lombiti kulo lonkhe ludzaba
color-wash.description: Libhurashi lelitsambile lipendvula imigeca lemibanti lembala lonkhe ludzaba lolulodvwa, ngemibala lemine kanye nobubanti bemabhurashi bobibili. Akukho sigcino sekuphela, akukho tinqintsho futsi akukho sikhashana. Kuyadlalwa ngaphandle kwemali, futsi kute i-akhawunti.
color-wash.short: Pendvula imigeca lemibanti yemibala kulo lonkhe ludzaba, ngelijubane lakho.
color-wash.intro: Ludzaba lulilobulodvwa kanye nelibhurashi lelitsambile. Khetsa umbala kanye nobubanti belibhurashi, bese uhudzula ludzaba ukuze ufake ingeca yembala. Ludzaba alunalo sigcino: alukho lutfo lokuphetsa, alukho sitfombe lekudzingeka situlungise, futsi alukho tinqintsho. Faka tingeca letinyenti lonato, noma bese ubeka libhurashi phansi ubuke nje. Ludzaba lulisha lisusa konkhe, futsi Buyisa kuyakubuyisa konkhe.
howTo: Khetsa umbala. Umbala ngamunye unemagama alo abhalwe.
Khetsa Kubanti noma Kubanti kakhulu. Kubanti kakhulu kumboza ludzaba lusukela kulo lonkhe ngemgca ngamunye.
Hudzula ludzaba ngasemunwe, ngemouse noma ngepenseli ukuze ufake ingeca.
Noma sebentisa tikhiye letimitsi ukuze uhambise lilingi lelibhurashi, futsi Space ukuze ubeke libhurashi phansi noma uliphakamise.
Thinta "Ludzaba lulisha" ukuze uhlanze ludzaba, bese "Buyisa" uma ufuna tingeca tibuyele.
tips: Vumela umuntu lotsite akhetse umbala wengeca lelandzelako, futsi nicoca ngemibala njengoba itfusa.
Kubanti kakhulu kulula kulawulwa uma sandla siyashaya, ngoba libhurashi aludzingi kuba lichanekile.
Akukho indlela lelungile yekupendvula. Yima nanoma nini lapho ufuna khona, noma thinta "Kuphelile kulesikhatsi".

faq.q: Ingabe kukhona kuphela, umphumela noma sikhashana?
faq.a: Cha. Ludzaba alunalo sigcino. Lutfo aluphelelwa, alubalwa, alukalwa sikhatsi, futsi alukho umyalezo lobuya ukucela ukuba wentse lokuningi.
Cha. Akukho lokugcinwa, lokushicilelwa noma lokutfunyelwa naliphi indzawo. Tingeca tihlala kulo ludzaba kuze kube usuphuma kulo.

faq.q: Ngingasebentisa lokhu ngaphandle kwemouse noma sikrini lesitfintfekako?
faq.a: Yebo. Uma ludzaba lugcile, tikhiye letimitsi lihambisa lilingi lelibhurashi, futsi kukhiya i-Space lubeka libhurashi phansi noma luliphakamise. Sikrini sitsi "Libhurashi liphansi" noma "Libhurashi liphakamile" njalo nje.
Cha. Ukupendvula ngemibala yetiyeneta ephepheni kunemcondvo lofanako, libhurashi lelimanzi kanye nemibala leyodvwa ngesikhatsi, kungako kuyinsebenti lehlukile lengatsi kutfola etafuleni.

Lokuphuzi, lokuwolintji, lokuluhlaza kanye nalokuvelengi, yona lemine leyafanako lesetjentiswe kwetinye titsombo tetfu tetitfombe. Ngumbala ngamunye unemagama lawo abhaliwe, futsi ligama libonakala ngasemakhangeni.
